facts.material: electrolytic cell cartridge (electrodes/housing; composition not stated)
facts.function: electrolytically generates chlorine from salt in spa water
facts.form: replaceable cartridge (cell) of a salt chlorinator system

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8543 covers electrical apparatus for electrolysis (8543.30) and parts thereof; Section XVI note 2(a)/(b) parts rule: parts suitable solely or principally for machines of heading 8543 go to 8543.90
GRI 6: 8543.90.88 Parts, Other, Other, Other; 8543.90.88.85 Other

rejected_alternatives.reason: cartridge is an apparatus, not chlorine itself
not a filtering/purifying machine; it generates chlorine electrolytically
if imported as complete electrolysis apparatus; a cartridge alone is a part

missing_facts: whether cartridge is the electrolytic cell itself or a consumable/filter
whether imported with the control unit as a set
classification.rationale: Cartridge is the electrode cell of a salt-water chlorinator, an electrolysis apparatus of 8543.30, so it is a part under 8543.90; F89627 (in force) put electrolysis machine components producing chlorine in 8543.90.8880, which now maps to 8543.90.88.85 Other.
